purpose: Build and compare one explicitly assumption-bound alternative to S; no target-accuracy, promotion, or upload claim.

scope.comparison_scope: official 9,379 GEOIDs only; the 415 eastern-WA rows have no scored-region feature inputs and are formatting-only, with no target claim

explicit_recipe.base: C2_component_estimator_v0 component outputs and reports/gap-estimates.csv per-component defined flags; this is the frozen feature-only component recipe audited by H1b. Do not use S as a base and do not apply S's cross-method reliability weights or region-mean shrink.

building.rule: when share is finite and in [0,1], building_gap_S2 = building_gap_C2 * (1 - share); when share is missing, preserve building_gap_C2 unchanged
building.assumption: A Microsoft-sourced Overture record is treated as an exact overlap with the removed Microsoft reference solely for this counterfactual; this is unverified and not accuracy evidence

poi_facilities.inputs: fire_gap/fire_defined, ems_gap/ems_defined, schools_gap/schools_defined from frozen reports/gap-estimates.csv plus raw Overture category counts from provided tract summaries
poi_facilities.rule: drop each facility type from the facilities half iff that tract's raw overture_poi_<type> count is exactly zero; retain other types only when their frozen per-type defined flag is true; facilities half is the arithmetic mean of retained defined type gaps, or undefined if no type remains
poi_facilities.assumption: Overture category count zero is treated as a zero reference count for this scenario only; USGS reference counts are absent and this premise is unverified

explicit_recipe.poi_establishments: preserve the frozen cbp_gap/cbp_defined establishment half without correction; this is an internal feature-only proxy, not a CBP reference count
explicit_recipe.poi_composite: mean of whichever facilities half and establishment half are defined; undefined if neither is defined; preserve no hidden-reference mask
explicit_recipe.transport: preserve C2 transport_gap and transport_defined unchanged
explicit_recipe.overall_composite: arithmetic mean of the defined transport, adjusted building, and adjusted POI component values; omit undefined components; deterministic 0.0 export fallback only if no component is defined
explicit_recipe.coefficient_or_fit: none; no fitted/estimated coefficients, target moments, or S-style shrink
explicit_recipe.input_construction_ambiguity: H1b's exact component-level stress-test is defined on C2 and its frozen per-type recipe values. A1/A2/A3 expose aggregate component columns but no separate facility-type decompositions, so S2 uses the exact C2/H1b component path rather than inventing per-type splits for A-family candidates. S and C2 remain explicit comparison baselines.

statistics: per-region defined component means for transport/building/POI
share of official-region tracts whose composite differs from S and from C2
comparison.changed_definition: absolute composite difference > 1e-12; computed on official GEOIDs only
comparison.S_component_means: null/not identifiable from S artifact, which contains only GEOID and coverage_gap_score; do not infer component decomposition
comparison.target_accuracy: not identifiable; no labels or organizer references

frozen_inputs.provided_feature_and_strata_hashes: use hashes frozen in config/shrink-h1b-rule-level-preregistered.json for each region; consume only the listed Overture and population/land/urbanity columns

forbidden: leaderboard/public/private scores or scorecards, including any algebra or comparison involving those values
labels, sample score placeholders, removed references or equivalent copies, external data
fitting, target-moment calibration, coefficient search, or using S/C2 agreement as accuracy evidence
modifying S, changing the final-two protocol, or uploading/submitting from this row

acceptance.side_by_side_comparison: S vs S2 vs C2 per region, including composite mean, component means or explicit non-identifiability, and changed-tract shares
